data.output:
Here is a script that renames your photos by the day they were taken. It reads each photo's EXIF DateTimeOriginal and names it like 2026-11-16_001.jpg, numbering the photos from one day in the order they were taken.

```python
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image

photos = []
for p in Path('.').glob('*.jpg'):
    taken = Image.open(p).getexif().get_ifd(0x8769).get(36867)  # DateTimeOriginal
    if taken:
        photos.append((taken, p))

per_day = {}
for taken, p in sorted(photos):
    day = taken[:10].replace(':', '-')
    per_day[day] = per_day.get(day, 0) + 1
    p.rename(f'{day}_{per_day[day]:03d}{p.suffix.lower()}')
```

Run it in the folder with your photos: `python rename_photos.py`. It needs Pillow (`pip install pillow`).

When results come back, write one clear answer for the person. Never invent a result a specialist did not return. If a specialist failed, say what failed. /tiers/raw.yaml:
# Which model backs each tier. Edit this file to swap models; no code changes needed.
# Run `pnpm models:sync` afterwards: it checks every model here against what each provider really has.
#
# Everything runs locally through Ollama by default. Providers marked `local: false` are only used when
# ONYX_CLOUD=on is set in .env AND their API key is present. Otherwise they are skipped, not tried. Both can be set
# in the app: Settings, Cloud models.
version: 1

providers:
  ollama:
    base_url: http://localhost:11434/v1
    base_url_env: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
    local: true
  moonshot:
    base_url: https://api.moonshot.ai/v1
    base_url_env: MOONSHOT_BASE_URL
    api_key_env: MOONSHOT_API_KEY
    local: false
  # ChatGPT's models, through OpenAI's API (a key from platform.openai.com, billed by OpenAI).
  openai:
    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1
    base_url_env: OPENAI_BASE_URL
    api_key_env: OPENAI_API_KEY
    local: false
    api: openai
  # Claude, through Anthropic's API (a key from console.anthropic.com, billed by Anthropic).
  anthropic:
    base_url: https://api.anthropic.com
    base_url_env: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
    api_key_env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    local: false
    api: anthropic

# price: USD per million tokens. Local models cost nothing per call. `price: null` means "not known":
# the call is logged with no cost rather than a made-up one.
models:
  # Thinking: Qwen3 models think before answering unless told not to. Through Ollama, `reasoning_effort: none`
  # turns it off on the 8B and 14B (Qwen's own "/no_think" switch is ignored there). The 4B and 30B tags now point to
  # Qwen's July 2025 versions, which come in two kinds: "-instruct" never thinks, the plain tag always does.
  # Measured: with thinking on, the router spent its whole allowance thinking and never made its tool call.
  qwen-lite:     { provider: ollama, id: "qwen3:4b-instruct", family: qwen, price: { input: 0, output: 0 }, extra: { reasoning_effort: "none" } }
  qwen-standard: { provider: ollama, id: "qwen3:8b",  family: qwen, price: { input: 0, output: 0 }, extra: { reasoning_effort: "none" } }
  qwen-pro:      { provider: ollama, id: "qwen3:14b", family: qwen, price: { input: 0, output: 0 }, extra: { reasoning_effort: "none" } }
  # OpenAI's open-weight model: better at reasoning and tool calls than Qwen3 14B, and quick as a mixture of experts.
  # It cannot turn thinking off; "low" keeps it short.
  oss-pro:       { provider: ollama, id: "gpt-oss:20b", family: gpt-oss, price: { input: 0, output: 0 }, extra: { reasoning_effort: "low" } }
  # Reads attached images and describes them for the other models. It cannot call tools, so it never backs a tier.
  gemma-vision:  { provider: ollama, id: "gemma3:12b", family: gemma, price: { input: 0, output: 0 }, tools: false }
  # Max is the one tier that should think: the 30B model always does.
  qwen-max:      { provider: ollama, id: "qwen3:30b", family: qwen, price: { input: 0, output: 0 } }
  # Opt-in. IDs and prices come from third-party pages (checked 2026-11-16), not from Moonshot itself:
  # confirm both with `pnpm models:sync` and Moonshot's pricing page before relying on the cost figures.
  kimi-pro:      { provider: moonshot, id: kimi-k2.7-code, family: kimi, price: { input: 0.95, output: 4.0 } }
  kimi-max:      { provider: moonshot, id: kimi-k3,        family: kimi, price: { input: 3.0,  output: 15.0 } }
  # Claude (Anthropic), opt-in. IDs and prices from Anthropic's model list (2026-11-03). Haiku's price is for prompts
  # up to 100K tokens ($0.50 / $2.50 above that).
  claude-opus:   { provider: anthropic, id: claude-opus-5-5,   family: claude, label: "Claude Opus 5.5",   price: { input: 4.0, output: 20.0 } }
  claude-sonnet: { provider: anthropic, id: claude-sonnet-5-5, family: claude, label: "Claude Sonnet 5.5", price: { input: 2.0, output: 10.0 } }
  claude-haiku:  { provider: anthropic, id: claude-haiku-5-5,  family: claude, label: "Claude Haiku 5.5",  price: { input: 0.1, output: 0.5 } }
  # ChatGPT's models (OpenAI), opt-in. IDs from OpenAI's release notes; OpenAI's own pages disagreed on the prices
  # (checked 2026-11-18), so confirm them on OpenAI's pricing page and correct them in tiers.local.yaml if they differ.
  gpt-astra:     { provider: openai, id: gpt-6.2-astra, family: gpt, label: "ChatGPT: GPT-6.2 Astra", price: { input: 8.0, output: 40.0 } }
  gpt-sol:       { provider: openai, id: gpt-6.2-sol,   family: gpt, label: "ChatGPT: GPT-6.2 Sol",   price: { input: 2.0, output: 10.0 } }

# Models are tried in the order listed. A cloud model that isn't enabled is skipped.
tiers:
  lite:     { label: Lite,     use_for: "routing, classification, quick replies, formatting", models: [qwen-lite] }
  standard: { label: Standard, use_for: "normal chat, summaries, most agent steps",           models: [qwen-standard] }
  pro:      { label: Pro,      use_for: "coding, tool use, multi-step planning",              models: [kimi-pro, oss-pro, qwen-pro] }
  max:      { label: Max,      use_for: "hardest reasoning, long tasks, think-hard mode",     models: [kimi-max, qwen-max] }

# Billing is off: everything is local, so every tier is open and nothing is limited. Tokens are still counted.
# If you ever charge for Onyx, set `enabled: true`: each account's plan then decides which tiers it may use and how
# many tokens a day, and /api/billing reports what each account used and what it cost you.
billing:
  enabled: false

plans:
  free: { tiers: [lite, standard],           daily_tokens: 200000 }
  pro:  { tiers: [lite, standard, pro],      daily_tokens: 2000000 }
  max:  { tiers: [lite, standard, pro, max], daily_tokens: 10000000 }

fallback:
  retries: 2          # extra tries on the same model after a rate limit, a server error or a timeout
  backoff_ms: 500     # doubled on each retry
  drop_tier: true     # when every model in a tier has failed, try the tier below
  timeout_ms: 120000  # local models on a CPU are slow; raise this if long answers get cut off

# Turns saved facts into vectors so Memory can recall by meaning. Pull it with: ollama pull qwen3-embedding:0.6b
# Without it, Memory still works, matching on words.
embeddings:
  provider: ollama
  model: "qwen3-embedding:0.6b"

vision:
  model: gemma-vision

router:
  tier: lite
  timeout_ms: 20000
